description: This file contains the implementation of an immutable Metadata class, ImmutableMetadata, which wraps a JsonObject and provides methods for accessing and modifying metadata in an immutable fashion within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableMetadata
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Metadata interface, wrapping a JsonObject and providing methods for safe access and modification.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns a new empty Metadata instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableMetadata instance initialized with the provided JsonObject.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a boolean.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a number.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is an integer.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a long.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a double.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a string.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is an object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is an array.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is null.

methods.name: asBoolean
methods.description: Returns the boolean value of the wrapped JSON.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Returns the integer value of the wrapped JSON.

methods.name: asLong
methods.description: Returns the long value of the wrapped JSON.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Returns the double value of the wrapped JSON.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Returns the string value of the wrapped JSON.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns the object value of the wrapped JSON.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns the array value of the wrapped JSON.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a value for a given key in the metadata, returning a new Metadata instance.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a field or fields in the metadata, returning a new Metadata instance.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the metadata, returning a new Metadata instance.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the metadata.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonObject based on a JsonPointer, JsonFieldDefinition, or JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key or field definition.

methods.name: getValueOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a field definition or throws if absent.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns a list of all keys.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonField for a given key.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the metadata is empty.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of entries.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the JsonFields.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a stream of JsonFields.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the object using a SerializationContext.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Returns an upper bound estimate for string size.

methods.name: determineResult
methods.description: Helper method to determine if a new JsonObject differs from the current and return appropriate Metadata.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of this Metadata.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Returns a filtered JSON object based on schema version and predicate.
